title: Elections 2026
text:
NC House District Results
This is an original estimate inspired by NCFREE’s map of Roy Cooper’s Senate margin by House district. The article does not publish a district-level data table. Here, Senate votes from each county/precinct location are allocated across House districts in proportion to the NC House votes at that location. This is approximate, especially for early-voting sites, and is not NCFREE’s estimate. Positive margins favor Cooper; the margin is the Democratic minus Republican share of all votes. This uses the downloaded NCSBE results, not the article’s Nov. 4 snapshot. District boundaries are from the 2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line state legislative district files.
